desc_scripts: RisuAI macros ({{getvar}}, {{#if}}...), the card's display regex, its background and its music. Variables are kept per chat.
desc_chat: Where a reply writes <img="name"> or {{img::name}}, the card's image shows up. A mark with no matching asset stays as written.
lbl_cache: Keep a copy of RisuRealm images
desc_cache: Images of RisuRealm cards are downloaded the first time they show up and work offline after that.
usage_hint: Not in the app backup. Use the data button next to the extension (Settings > Extensions) to export or import it.
toast_reading: Risu's extra Rizz: reading the card's assets ({n})...
toast_imported: Risu's extra Rizz: assets of this card: {n} (stored: {stored}, downloaded when used: {remote}).
toast_skipped: Risu's extra Rizz: package images discarded: {n}.
ask_big: This card comes as a single package, so its {n} images ({mb} MB) were downloaded with it. Keep them on this device for the chat? Without them, the marks stay as written.
ask_continue: Downloaded {mb} MB so far ({n} of {total}). Keep going?
editor_hint: Images and sounds the card uses in the chat. Renaming, deleting and adding take effect when you save the character.
editor_empty: No assets. Cards imported before this extension was on need to be imported again.
editor_skipped: Embedded assets left out at import: {n}.
desc_prompt: Tells the model which images exist and how to call them. Automatic: only for cards that do not bring their own.
toast_script_slow: Risu's extra Rizz: the card regex "{name}" took too long and was skipped on that message.
